data: Only operational MEO commercial broadband — 20+ sats
SES O3b constellation. Original O3b deployed 2013-2019; mPOWER successors launching since 2022 with software-defined beam allocation.

The only operational commercial MEO broadband constellation — original O3b deployed 2013-2019, second-generation O3b mPOWER from 2022 onwards. 20+ satellites at 8,063 km equatorial orbit. Latency between GEO and LEO, customer base focused on telecom backhaul, maritime, and remote enterprise. Operated by SES (Luxembourg). Named for the 'other 3 billion' — the original mission was bringing connectivity to areas not served by terrestrial broadband.
Europe's civilian GNSS — ~30 sats, sub-metre positioning
Polar LEO comms — 66 operational sats +9 spares, GMDSS partner, global voice/data
Largest LEO broadband constellation — over 11,000 active satellites (as of October 2026)
First-gen LEO broadband — 648 sats in 12 polar planes

20 satellites at 8,063 km equatorial MEO — only operational MEO commercial broadband. O3b mPOWER successors launching since 2022 with software-defined beam allocation. Lower latency than GEO, more coverage than LEO; aimed at the 'other 3 billion' (origin of the name).
